result.summary: The page appears visually well-formed overall. No critical or major visual defects were found; only a couple of minor cosmetic observations.

issues.description: The rating '4.8 (500+)' for Tokumaru Ramen Bar sits on the same baseline as the restaurant title, causing the title row to feel crowded; on longer restaurant names the title and rating could collide.
issues.suggestion: Reserve fixed space for the rating or allow the title to truncate with an ellipsis so the two elements never overlap.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '€0.90 delivery') uses low-contrast gray on white, which is somewhat hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken the secondary text color to improve readability and meet WCAG AA contrast for small text.
